52600.meaning1: with wrong view as the utmost; with incorrect belief as the supreme
52600.commentary: (ANa) micchādiṭṭhiparamānī'ti micchādiṭṭhi paramā etesan'ti micchādiṭṭhiparamāni. pañca hi ānantariyakammāni mahāsāvajjāni nāma, tehi'pi micchādiṭṭhi'y'eva mahāsāvajjatarā'ti adhippāyo. kasmā? tesañ'hi paricchedo atthi. cattāri hi ānantariyakammāni niraye nibbattāpentī'ti vuttāni.

examples.text: n'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, aññaṃ ekadhammam'pi samanupassāmi yaṃ evaṃ mahāsāvajjaṃ yatha'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, micchādiṭṭhi. micchādiṭṭhiparamāni, bhikkhave, mahāsāvajjānī'ti.

52601.meaningLit: discourse on the abandoning of wrong view

52603.meaning1: taking up wrong views; believing wrong theories

examples.text: alajjitāye lajjanti, lajjitāye na lajjare, micchādiṭṭhisamādānā, sattā gacchanti duggatiṃ.
abhaye bhayadassino, bhaye c'ābhayadassino, micchādiṭṭhisamādānā, sattā gacchanti duggatiṃ.

52607.meaning1: due to the subsiding of wrong view
52607.commentary: (SNa) micchādiṭṭhi-vūpasama-paccayā'ti micchādiṭṭhi-vūpasamo nāma sammādiṭṭhi. tasmā yaṃ sammādiṭṭhipaccayā vedayitaṃ vuttaṃ, tadeva micchādiṭṭhi-vūpasama-paccayā veditabbaṃ.

examples.text: so evaṃ pajānāmi, micchādiṭṭhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, micchādiṭṭhi-vūpasama-paccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, sammādiṭṭhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, sammādiṭṭhi-vūpasama-paccayā'pi vedayitaṃ … micchāsamādhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, micchāsamādhi-vūpasama-paccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, sammāsamādhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ

52608.meaning1: afflicted with wrong view; beaten by wrong view; hammered by wrong view

examples.text: anicce niccasaññino, dukkhe ca sukhasaññino, anattani ca attā'ti, asubhe subhasaññino, micchādiṭṭhihatā sattā, khittacittā visaññino.
pañcavassasat'āyukesu, bhikkhave, manussesu tayo dhammā vepullam'agamaṃsu. adhammarāgo visamalobho micchādhammo. tīsu dhammesu vepullaṃ gatesu tesaṃ sattānaṃ āyu'pi parihāyi, vaṇṇo'pi parihāyi.

52610.meaning1: afflicted with immorality; suffering from perversity

examples.text: eta'r'ahi, brāhmaṇa, manussā adhammarāgarattā visamalobh'ābhibhūtā micchādhammaparetā. te adhammarāgarattā visamalobh'ābhibhūtā micchādhammaparetā tiṇhāni satthāni gahetvā aññam'aññaṃ jīvitā voropenti, tena bahū manussā kālaṃ karonti.
dvīsu, bhikkhave, micchāpaṭipajjamāno bālo abyatto asappuriso khataṃ upahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati, sāvajjo ca hoti sānuvajjo ca viññūnaṃ, bahuñ'ca apuññaṃ pasavati. katamesu dvīsu?

52612.commentary: (SNa) micchāpaṭipatt'ādhikaraṇahetū'ti micchāpaṭipattikaraṇahetu. yasmā micchāpaṭipattiṃ karoti, tasmā'ti attho.

examples.text: gihī vā hi, māṇava, pabbajito vā micchāpaṭipanno micchāpaṭipatt'ādhikaraṇahetu na ārādhako hoti ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusalaṃ. gihissa v'āhaṃ, māṇava, pabbajitassa vā sammāpaṭipattiṃ vaṇṇemi.

52613.meaning1: wrong practice; following the wrong road

examples.text: asussūsā aparipucchā paññāya paripantho, ananuyogo apaccavekkhaṇā dhammānaṃ paripantho, micchāpaṭipatti saggānaṃ paripantho

52614.meaning1: wrong course; wrong path of action

examples.text: tatra, bhikkhave, yam'idaṃ taramānassa bhāsitaṃ, sadukkho eso dhammo saupaghāto saupāyāso sapariḷāho, micchāpaṭipadā.
gihino v'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, pabbajitassa vā micchāpaṭipadaṃ na vaṇṇemi. gihi vā, bhikkhave, pabbajito vā micchāpaṭipanno micchāpaṭipatt'ādhikaraṇahetu n'ārādhako hoti ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusalaṃ.

52615.meaning1: practising wrongly; going the wrong way

examples.text: micchāpaṭipanno tvam'asi, aham'asmi sammāpaṭipanno. sahitaṃ me, asahitaṃ te. purevacanīyaṃ pacchā avaca, pacchāvacanīyaṃ pure avaca. adhiciṇṇaṃ te viparāvattaṃ. āropito te vādo, cara vādappamokkhāya. niggahito'si, nibbeṭhehi vā sace pahosī'ti.
yesaṃ kesañci bhavasaṃyojanaṃ appahīnaṃ, sabbe te sadukkhā saupaghātā saupāyāsā sapariḷāhā micchāpaṭipannā'ti, iti vadaṃ itth'eke apasādeti.

52616.meaning1: badly directed; wrongly orientated; at a wrong angle

examples.text: diso disaṃ yaṃ taṃ kayirā, verī vā pana verinaṃ, micchāpaṇihitaṃ cittaṃ, pāpiyo naṃ tato kare.
micchāpaṇihitaṃ kho, mahāli, cittaṃ hetu, micchāpaṇihitaṃ cittaṃ paccayo pāpassa kammassa kiriyāya pāpassa kammassa pavattiyāti.

52617.meaning1: fact of being badly directed; fact of being wrongly orientated; fact of being at a wrong angle
52617.commentary: (SNa) micchāpaṇihitattā, bhikkhave, diṭṭhiyā'ti kammassakatapaññāya c'eva maggabhāvanāya ca micchā ṭhapitattā, appavattitattā'ti attho.

examples.text: taṃ kissa hetu? micchāpaṇihitattā, bhikkhave, diṭṭhiyā.

52619.meaning1: to show the wrong state of being
52619.meaningLit: for the purpose of showing the wrong state

examples.text: kummaggo'ti kho, bhikkhave, aṭṭh'aṅgikass'etaṃ micchāmaggassa adhivacanaṃ, seyyath'idaṃ, micchādiṭṭhiyā micchāsaṅkappassa micchāvācāya micchākamm'antassa micchāājīvassa micchāvāyāmassa micchāsatiyā micchāsamādhissa.

52621.meaning1: wrong intention; incorrect notion; false idea; wrong concept

examples.text: asāre sāramatino, sāre c'āsāradassino, te sāraṃ n'ādhigacchanti, micchāsaṅkappagocarā.
kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, sammādiṭṭhi pubbaṅ'gamā hoti? micchāsaṅkappaṃ, micchāsaṅkappo'ti pajānāti, sammāsaṅkappaṃ, sammāsaṅkappo'ti pajānāti, s'āssa hoti sammādiṭṭhi.

52622.meaning1: having wrong intention; with wrong notions; with wrong ideas

examples.text: pare micchāsaṅkappā bhavissanti, mayam'ettha sammāsaṅkappā bhavissāmā'ti sallekho karaṇīyo.

evam'eva kho, cunda, vihiṃsakassa purisapuggalassa avihiṃsā hoti parikkamanāya… micchādiṭṭhissa purisapuggalassa sammādiṭṭhi hoti parikkamanāya, micchāsaṅkappassa purisapuggalassa sammāsaṅkappo hoti parikkamanāya

52623.meaning1: having wrong mindfulness; with incorrect present moment awareness

examples.text: pare micchāsatī bhavissanti, mayam'ettha sammāsatī bhavissāmā'ti sallekho karaṇīyo.

evam'eva kho, cunda, vihiṃsakassa purisapuggalassa avihiṃsā hoti parikkamanāya… micchāsatissa purisapuggalassa sammāsati hoti parikkamanāya, micchāsamādhissa purisapuggalassa sammāsamādhi hoti parikkamanāya

52624.meaning1: wrong mindfulness; incorrect present moment awareness; imperfect memory

examples.text: kummaggo'ti kho, bhikkhave, aṭṭh'aṅgikass'etaṃ micchāmaggassa adhivacanaṃ, seyyath'idaṃ, micchādiṭṭhiyā micchāsaṅkappassa micchāvācāya micchākamm'antassa micchāājīvassa micchāvāyāmassa micchāsatiyā micchāsamādhissa.

52625.meaning1: having wrong mindfulness; with incorrect present moment awareness

examples.text: evam'eva kho, rājañña, yathārūpe yaññe gāvo vā haññanti, aj'eḷakā vā haññanti, kukkuṭasūkarā vā haññanti, vividhā vā pāṇā saṃghātaṃ āpajjanti, paṭiggāhakā ca honti micchādiṭṭhī micchāsaṅkappā micchāvācā micchākamm'antā micchāājīvā micchāvāyāmā micchāsatī micchāsamādhī, evarūpo kho, rājañña, yañño na mahapphalo hoti na mah'ānisaṃso na mahājutiko na mahāvipphāro.

52627.meaning1: having imperfect stability of mind; with incorrect meditative composure

examples.text: pare micchāsamādhi bhavissanti, mayam'ettha sammāsamādhī bhavissāmā'ti sallekho karaṇīyo.

evam'eva kho, cunda, vihiṃsakassa purisapuggalassa avihiṃsā hoti parikkamanāya… micchāsatissa purisapuggalassa sammāsati hoti parikkamanāya, micchāsamādhissa purisapuggalassa sammāsamādhi hoti parikkamanāya

52628.meaning1: imperfect stability of mind; incorrect meditative composure

examples.text: aṭṭha micchattā, micchādiṭṭhi, micchāsaṅkappo, micchāvācā, micchākamm'anto, micchāājīvo, micchāvāyāmo micchāsati, micchāsamādhi.
katamā ca, bhikkhave, micchāpaṭipadā? seyyath'idaṃ, micchādiṭṭhi… micchāsamādhi. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, micchāpaṭipadā.

52629.meaning1: dependent on incorrect stability of mind; due to wrong meditative composure

examples.text: so evaṃ pajānāmi, micchādiṭṭhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, sammādiṭṭhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ… micchāsamādhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, sammāsamādhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, chandapaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, vitakkapaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, saññāpaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ

52630.meaning1: due to the subsiding of incorrect meditative composure

examples.text: so evaṃ pajānāmi, micchādiṭṭhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, micchādiṭṭhi-vūpasama-paccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, sammādiṭṭhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, sammādiṭṭhi-vūpasama-paccayā'pi vedayitaṃ … micchāsamādhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, micchāsamādhi-vūpasama-paccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, sammāsamādhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ

52631.meaning1: speaking wrongly; with bad speech; badly spoken

examples.text: pare micchāvācā bhavissanti, mayam'ettha sammāvācā bhavissāmā'ti sallekho karaṇīyo.

evam'eva kho, cunda, vihiṃsakassa purisapuggalassa avihiṃsā hoti parikkamanāya… micchāvāc'assa purisapuggalassa sammāvācā hoti parikkamanāya, micchākamm'antassa purisapuggalassa sammākamm'anto hoti parikkamanāya

kummaggo'ti kho, bhikkhave, aṭṭh'aṅgikass'etaṃ micchāmaggassa adhivacanaṃ, seyyath'idaṃ, micchādiṭṭhiyā micchāsaṅkappassa micchāvācāya micchākamm'antassa micchāājīvassa micchāvāyāmassa micchāsatiyā micchāsamādhissa.
iti pubb'eva kho pan'assa susīlyaṃ pahīnaṃ hoti, dussīlyaṃ paccupaṭṭhitaṃ, ayañ'ca micchādiṭṭhi micchāsaṅkappo micchāvācā ariyānaṃ paccanīkatā asaddhammasaññatti attukkaṃsanā paravambhanā.

52634.meaning1: with wrong effort; having incorrect endeavour

examples.text: pare micchāvāyāmā bhavissanti, mayam'ettha sammāvāyāmā bhavissāmā'ti sallekho karaṇīyo.

evam'eva kho, cunda, vihiṃsakassa purisapuggalassa avihiṃsā hoti parikkamanāya… micchāājīvassa purisapuggalassa sammāājīvo hoti parikkamanāya, micchāvāyāmassa purisapuggalassa sammāvāyāmo hoti parikkamanāya

kummaggo'ti kho, bhikkhave, aṭṭh'aṅgikass'etaṃ micchāmaggassa adhivacanaṃ, seyyath'idaṃ, micchādiṭṭhiyā micchāsaṅkappassa micchāvācāya micchākamm'antassa micchāājīvassa micchāvāyāmassa micchāsatiyā micchāsamādhissa.

katame dasa dhammā pahātabbā? dasa micchattā, micchādiṭṭhi, micchāsaṅkappo, micchāvācā, micchākamm'anto, micchāājīvo, micchāvāyāmo, micchāsati, micchāsamādhi, micchāñāṇaṃ, micchāvimutti. ime dasa dhammā pahātabbā.

52638.meaning1: having incorrect liberation; with wrong emancipation
52638.commentary: (MNa) micchāvimuttī'ti avimuttā'y'eva samānā, vimuttā mayan'ti evaṃsaññino, avimuttiyaṃ vā vimuttisaññino. tatr'āyaṃ vacan'attho, micchā pāpikā viparītā vimutti etesaṃ atthī'ti micchāvimuttī.

examples.text: pare micchāvimuttī bhavissanti, mayam'ettha sammāvimuttī bhavissāmā'ti sallekho karaṇīyo.

evam'eva kho, cunda, vihiṃsakassa purisapuggalassa avihiṃsā hoti parikkamanāya… micchāñāṇissa purisapuggalassa sammāñāṇaṃ hoti parikkamanāya, micchāvimuttissa purisapuggalassa sammāvimutti hoti parikkamanāya.

52639.meaning1: dependent on wrong liberation; based on incorrect deliverance

examples.text: sammāvimuttissa micchāvimutti nijjiṇṇā hoti. ye ca micchāvimuttipaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti, te c'assa nijjiṇṇā honti. ime dasa dhammā abhiññeyyā.
haritako haritapaṇṇavaṇṇo. miñjāya pana palaṇḍukassa ekā miñjā hoti, bhañjanakassa dve, haritakassa tisso. cāpalasuṇo amiñjako, aṅkuramattam'eva hi tassa hoti.

kesā lomā nakhā dantā taco maṃsaṃ nhāru aṭṭhi aṭṭhimiñjaṃ vakkaṃ hadayaṃ yakanaṃ kilomakaṃ pihakaṃ papphāsaṃ antaṃ antaguṇaṃ udariyaṃ karīsaṃ, yaṃ vā pan'aññam'pi kiñci ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ kakkhaḷaṃ kharigataṃ upādinnaṃ, ayaṃ vuccati, rāhula, ajjhattikā pathavīdhātu.

dvattikkhattuṃ kho bhavaṃ gotamo mukhe ālopaṃ samparivattetvā ajjhoharati, na c'assa kāci odanamiñjā asambhinnā kāyaṃ pavisati, na c'assa kāci odanamiñjā mukhe avasiṭṭhā hoti, ath'āparaṃ ālopaṃ upanāmeti.

52649.meaning2: to measure, to weigh, to balance

52650.meaning2: having measured, having weighed, having balanced

examples.text: ūn'ūdaro mita-āhāro, app'icchassa alolupo, sadā icchāya nicchāto, aniccho hoti nibbuto.
porāṇam'etaṃ atula, n'etaṃ ajjatanām'iva, nindanti tuṇhim'āsīnaṃ, nindanti bahubhāṇinaṃ, mitabhāṇim'pi nindanti, n'atthi loke anindito.

52653.meaning1: of value; in measure; worth as much as
52653.commentary: (SNa) sahassena samaṃ mitā'ti sahassena saddhiṃ mitā, sahassa dānasadisā hoti.

examples.text: appasm'eke pavecchanti, bahun'eke na dicchare, appasmā dakkhiṇā dinnā, sahassena samaṃ mitā'ti.

52655.meaning1: speaking in moderation; who is measured in speech
52655.commentary: (DHPa) mitabhāṇimpī'ti kiṃ esa suvaṇṇahiraññaṃ viya attano vacanaṃ maññamāno ekaṃ vā dve vā vatvā tuṇhī ahosī'ti nindanti. evaṃ sabbathā'pi imasmiṃ loke anindito nāma n'atthī'ti attho. (APAa) mitabhāṇī'ti pamāṇaṃ ñatvā bhaṇanasīlo, pamāṇaṃ jānitvā dhammaṃ desesī'ti attho.

examples.text: porāṇam'etaṃ atula, n'etaṃ ajjatanām'iva, nindanti tuṇhim'āsīnaṃ, nindanti bahubhāṇinaṃ, mitabhāṇim'pi nindanti, n'atthi loke anindito.

52656.meaning1: moderate in food; limited in eating; with lean diet

examples.text: allaṃ sukkhaṃ vā bhuñjanto, na bāḷhaṃ suhito siyā, ūn'ūdaro mit'āhāro, sato bhikkhu paribbaje.
ūn'ūdaro mit'āhāro, app'icchassa alolupo, sadā icchāya nicchāto, aniccho hoti nibbuto.
mitte bhajassu kalyāṇe, suddhājīve atandite, paṭisanthāravuty'assa, ācārakusalo siyā, tato pāmojjabahulo, dukkhass'antaṃ karissati.
yādisaṃ kurute mittaṃ, yādisaṃ c'ūpasevati, sa ve tādisako hoti, sahavāso hi tādiso.

52658.commentary: (SNPa) dadan'ti yaṃkiñci icchitapatthitaṃ dadanto mittāni ganthati, sampādeti karotī'ti attho. duddadaṃ vā dadaṃ ganthati, dānamukhena vā cattāri'pi saṅgahavatthūni gahitānī'ti veditabbāni. tehi mittāni karotī'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: patirūpakārī dhuravā, uṭṭhātā vindate dhanaṃ, saccena kittiṃ pappoti, dadaṃ mittāni ganthati.
saṅgāhako mittakaro, vadaññū vītamaccharo, netā vinetā anunetā, tādiso labhate yasaṃ.
patirūpe vase dese, ariyamittakaro siyā, sammāpaṇidhisampanno, pubbe puññakato naro, dhaññaṃ dhanaṃ yaso kitti, sukhañ'c'etaṃ'dhivattatī'ti. paṭhamaṃ.
atthi, bhante, pubbavijjanaṃ nāma vajjigāmo. tatth'āyasmato channassa mittakulāni suhajjakulāni upavajjakulānī'ti.
honti h'ete, sāriputta, channassa bhikkhuno mittakulāni suhajjakulāni upavajjakulāni.
uṭṭhānaṃ anālasyaṃ bhogānaṃ āhāro, maṇḍanā vibhūsanā vaṇṇassa āhāro, sappāyakiriyā ārogyassa āhāro, kalyāṇamittatā sīlānaṃ āhāro
kalyāṇamittatā muninā, lokaṃ ādissa vaṇṇitā, kalyāṇamitte bhajamāno, api bālo paṇḍito assa.

52662.commentary: (VINa) ñātakehi me cīvar'atthāya pesitaṃ, mittehi pesitaṃ, te āgatā cīvare dassantī'ti evaṃ ñātito vā mittato vā paccāsā hoti.

examples.text: uppajjeyyā'ti uppajjeyya saṅghato vā gaṇato vā ñātito vā mittato vā paṃsukūlaṃ vā attano vā dhanena.

52663.commentary: (MNa) mittato'pi naṃ saddaheyyā'ti mitto me ayan'ti saddaheyya.

examples.text: tassa so gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā mittato'pi naṃ saddaheyya, suhajjato'pi naṃ saddaheyya, tasmiñ'ca vissāsaṃ āpajjeyya.

52664.meaning1: fact of betraying one's friends; fact of being a false friend

examples.text: tatr'idaṃ, bhikkhave, mātugāmassa ghoravisatā, yebhuyyena, bhikkhave, mātugāmo tibbarāgo. tatr'idaṃ, bhikkhave, mātugāmassa dujjivhatā, yebhuyyena, bhikkhave, mātugāmo pisuṇavāco. tatr'idaṃ, bhikkhave, mātugāmassa mittadubbhitā, yebhuyyena, bhikkhave, mātugāmo aticārinī.

52665.meaning1: who betrays one's friends; who is a false friend
52665.meaning2: who betrays his friends, treacherous person

examples.text: asuci, duggandho, sabhīru, sappaṭibhayo, mittadubbhī, ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca ādīnavā kaṇhasappe. evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, pañc'ime ādīnavā mātugāme.

52666.meaning2: who betrays his friends, treacherous person

52667.meaning1: who betrays one's friends; treacherous person
52667.meaning2: who betrays his friends, treacherous person
52667.commentary: (SNPa) mittadduno'ti mittadūhakā, dāradhanajīvitesu vissāsam'āpannānaṃ mittānaṃ tattha micchāpaṭipajjanakā'ti vuttaṃ hoti. (JAa) mittadduno'ti ye tesaññ'eva gehe khāditvā bhuñjitvā paññattāsane nisīditvā sayitvā puna māsakahāpaṇaṃ nāma āharāpenti, lañjaṃ gaṇhanti, te mittadūsakā bālā evarūpaṃ mīḷhaṃ khādanti, mahārājā'ti. (SaDM) ettha mittaddū'ti mittaṃ dunāti hiṃsati dubbhatī'ti mittaddu. atra vedā na tāṇāya bhavanti tassa, mittadduno bhūnahuno narassā'ti pāḷi nidassanaṃ.

examples.text: ye lūkhasā dāruṇā piṭṭhimaṃsikā, mittadduno nikkaruṇā-atimānino, adānasīlā na ca denti kassaci, es'āmagandho na hi maṃsabhojanaṃ.
thīghātakā ye c'ime pāradārikā, mittadduno ye ca sapanti subbate, sabbe ca te maccharipañcam'ādhamā, tasmā adatvā udakam'pi nāsniye.

52668.commentary: (DNa) idāni yo evaṃ karoto anattho uppajjati, aññāni vā pana yāni kānici bhayāni yekeci upaddavā yekeci upasaggā, sabbe te bālaṃ nissāya uppajjanti. tasmā evarūpā bālā na sevitabbā'ti bāle mittapatirūpake amitte dassetuṃ cattāro'me, gahapatiputta amittā'ti-ādim'āha.

examples.text: cattāro'me, gahapatiputta, amittā mittapatirūpakā veditabbā. añña'd'atthuharo amitto mittapatirūpako veditabbo, vacīparamo amitto mittapatirūpako veditabbo, anuppiyabhāṇī amitto mittapatirūpako veditabbo, apāyasahāyo amitto mittapatirūpako veditabbo.

52670.meaning1: companionship; close association with a friend; intimate acquaintance

52671.meaning1: way of close association with a friend; manner of intimate acquaintance

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, sapatto sapattassa evaṃ icchati, aho vat'āyaṃ na mittavā assā'ti! taṃ kissa hetu? na, bhikkhave, sapatto sapattassa mittavatāya nandati.
kathañ'c'ānanda, satthāraṃ sāvakā mittavatāya samudācaranti, no sapattavatāya?
puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, sapatto sapattassa evaṃ icchati, aho vat'āyaṃ na mittavā assā'ti! taṃ kissa hetu? na, bhikkhave, sapatto sapattassa mittavatāya nandati.

52686.meaning1: compassionate towards friends; sympathetic to friends

examples.text: upakāro ca yo mitto, sukhe dukkhe ca yo sakhā, atth'akkhāyī ca yo mitto, yo ca mitt'ānukampako.

52687.meaning1: obligation to friends and colleagues; responsibility to friends and companions

examples.text: kuto, bho sāriputta, amhākaṃ appamādo yesaṃ no… mitt'āmaccānaṃ mitt'āmaccakaraṇīyaṃ kātabbaṃ, ñātisālohitānaṃ ñātisālohitakaraṇīyaṃ kātabbaṃ, atithīnaṃ atithikaraṇīyaṃ kātabbaṃ, pubbapetānaṃ pubbapetakaraṇīyaṃ kātabbaṃ, devatānaṃ devatākaraṇīyaṃ kātabbaṃ, rañño rājakaraṇīyaṃ kātabbaṃ, ayam'pi kāyo pīṇetabbo brūhetabbo'ti?

52688.meaning1: friends and colleagues; friends and companions

examples.text: kodhanaṃ, bhikkhave, purisapuggalaṃ kodh'ābhibhūtaṃ kodhaparetaṃ, ye'pi'ssa te honti mitt'āmaccā ñātisālohitā, te'pi ārakā parivajjanti kodh'ābhibhūtaṃ.

tam'enaṃ mitt'āmaccā ñātisālohitā jātam'eva naṃ saṅghāṭikaṃ kareyyuṃ, saṅghāṭikattam'eva samādapeyyuṃ, ehi tvaṃ, bhadramukha, saṅghāṭiko hohi, saṅghāṭikassa te sato saṅghāṭidhāraṇamattena abhijjhālussa abhijjhā pahīyissati

52689.meaning1: friends, colleagues, family and blood relatives

examples.text: labheyya nu kho so coro coraghātesu, āgamentu tāva bhavanto coraghātā, amukasmiṃ me gāme vā nigame vā mitt'āmaccā ñātisālohitā, yāv'āhaṃ tesaṃ uddisitvā āgacchāmī'ti
seyyathā'pi, sunakkhatta, puriso sallena viddho assa savisena gāḷh'ūpalepanena. tassa mitt'āmaccā ñātisālohitā bhisakkaṃ sallakattaṃ upaṭṭhāpeyyuṃ.

52692.meaning1: display of friendship; demonstration of affection

examples.text: kiṃ pana tvaṃ, mahārāja, atthavasaṃ sampassamāno imasmiṃ sarīre evarūpaṃ paramanipaccakāraṃ karosi, mitt'ūpahāraṃ upadaṃsesī'ti?

52693.meaning1: name of a town; capital of the Videha country
52693.meaning2: name of a town; capital of the Videha country

examples.text: ath'addasāsiṃ sugataṃ, nagaraṃ mithilaṃ pati, adantānaṃ dametāraṃ, sambuddham'akutobhayaṃ.
mahesayaṃ avantīnaṃ, sovīrānañ'ca rorukaṃ, mithilā ca videhānaṃ, campā aṅgesu māpitā, bārāṇasī ca kāsīnaṃ, ete govindamāpitā'ti.

assosuṃ kho mithileyyakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā, samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito videhesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ pañcamattehi bhikkhusatehi mithilaṃ anuppatto
te vādakāmā parisaṃ vigayha, bālaṃ dahantī mithu aññam'aññaṃ, vadanti te aññasitā kath'ojjaṃ, pasaṃsakāmā kusalā vadānā.
na v'āham'etaṃ tathiyan'ti brūmi, yam'āhu bālā mithu aññam'aññaṃ, sakaṃ sakaṃ diṭṭhim'akaṃsu saccaṃ, tasmā hi bālo'ti paraṃ dahanti.

52697.meaning2: pair of a male and a female

52698.commentary: (DNa) eko, iminā akathitaṃ amussa, amunā akathitaṃ imassā'ti vadantānaṃ pisuṇavācānaṃ vasena bhinnānaṃ manussānaṃ aññam'aññabheden'eva nassissatī'ti attho.

examples.text: pāṭaliputtassa kho, ānanda, tayo antarāyā bhavissanti, aggito vā udakato vā mithubhedā vā'ti.
ubhayena m'idaṃ maraṇam'eva, n'āmaraṇaṃ pacchā vā pure vā, paṭipajjatha mā vinassatha, khaṇo vo mā upaccagā.
